body.raw:
{
  "passwordHashAlgorithm": "SCRYPT",
  "dbEncryptionAlgorithm": "AES_256_GCM",
  "encryptFieldsAtRest": true,
  "mfaPolicy": "OPTIONAL",
  "allowedMfaMethods": [
    "TOTP"
  ],
  "maxFailedLoginAttempts": 3,
  "lockoutDurationMinutes": 1,
  "passwordMinLength": 6,
  "requireUppercase": true,
  "requireNumbers": true,
  "requireSpecialChars": true,
  "requireCurrentPasswordOnChange": true,
  "disallowedPasswords": [
    "disallowedPasswords_sample"
  ],
  "disallowUserInfoInPassword": true,
  "preventPasswordReuse": true,
  "passwordHistoryLimit": 1,
  "revokeSessionsOnPasswordChange": true,
  "allowEmailRegistration": true,
  "allowPhoneRegistration": true,
  "requireEmailVerification": true,
  "requirePhoneVerification": true,
  "otpMaxSendCount": 1,
  "otpMaxAttempts": 1,
  "otpCooldownSeconds": 0,
  "sessionIdleTimeoutMinutes": 0,
  "sessionMaxLifetimeMinutes": 5,
  "enableLoginAuditLog": true
}
